rules.description: Checks that the percentage of deleted records is within the 7% threshold. Justification: Accommodates up to 6.94% deletions observed in sub-imports (6.94% in sub_division_wise_annual_rainfall and 5.64% in agriculture) due to: (1) place resolution fixes remapping 'Haryana, Delhi & Chandigarh' from Q1174 to dcid:HaryanaDelhiChandigarh and 'NCT of Delhi' from Q1352 (Chennai) to Q9357528, (2) unit correction for Annual_Amount_FarmInventory_Fruits from Hectare to MetricTon, and (3) official RBI retrospective revisions to provisional historical data.
Verifies that summary_report.csv is non-empty and contains at least one StatVar.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT StatVar) AS statvar_cnt FROM stats

rules.description: Verifies that each table meets its expected freshness threshold according to RBI publishing cadence.

params.query: SELECT StatVar, CASE WHEN StatVar IN ('Length_Transportation_Road', 'Length_Transportation_StateHighway') THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2020' WHEN StatVar IN ('Consumption_FarmInventory_Fertilizer') THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2022' WHEN StatVar IN ('Area_LandCover_Forest', 'Score_SustainableDevelopmentGoals', 'Area_LandCover_Tree', 'Loss_Electricity_TransmissionAndDistribution_AsAFractionOf_Annual_Generation_Electricity', 'GrossValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland', 'NetValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland', 'Gross_Area_LandCover_IrrigatedLand', 'NetValue_Area_LandCover_IrrigatedLand', 'GrossValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland_AsAFractionOf_NetValue_Area_LandCover_Cropland') THEN MAX(MaxDate) >= '2023' ELSE MAX(MaxDate) >= '2024' END AS is_fresh, COUNT(*) AS row_cnt FROM stats WHERE MaxDate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY StatVar
